_what: Video ids a human opened, watched, and rejected. The title rules in tools/enrich_media.py catch most bad picks, but some only give themselves away to a person — a namesake town no rule knows about, a nest cam on a fjord, a broadcaster's channel instead of a view. Without this file the enricher happily re-finds them on the next sweep and the same lie comes back.
_shape: youtube id -> why it is not what it claimed to be
_rule: Only ever add an id you actually looked at. This file outranks every heuristic, in both enrich_media.py and prune_media.py.

hovden.MiV4YJJG2oI: "POV Driving Norway - Hovden Landscape Area" — the OTHER Hovden. The description says "the 9th road in Norway": Route 9 up Setesdal, past Hovden in Agder, the ski resort ~1,000 km south. Mountain pass, not a sea-level fishing village at 68.8N. Norway has two Hovdens and search cannot tell them apart; anything for this place must name Vesteralen, Bo, Langoya or Nordland.
hovden.rPIQXV-wkkg: "Driving in Norway || Hovden || tour" — the Setesdal Hovden again. Frames show an inland alpine valley: birch scrub, spruce, dark-timber hytter, snowed-in fells, no sea in any direction. Hovden in Vesteralen sits at sea level with open ocean on two sides and barely a tree.
